# `cue-sheet` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "cue-sheet" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/cue-sheet/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Sheet id, e.g. "combat". |
| `notes` | string | required | What the sheet covers and why, for owner review. |
| `rules` | list of object (at least 1) | required | The rules, most specific wins per event and layer. |
| `rules[].event` | `"DamageApplied"` \| `"PoiseBroken"` \| `"Died"` \| `"HitParried"` \| `"GuardBroken"` \| `"DodgedHit"` \| `"ActionPhaseChanged"` \| `"LocomotionEvents"` \| `"WaterEntered"` \| `"TelegraphStarted"` \| `"AttackHit"` \| `"AttackProjectileLaunched"` \| `"AttackEnded"` \| `"ActionRejected"` \| `"StaminaExhausted"` \| `"StaminaRecovered"` \| `"fireIgnited"` \| `"fireExtinguished"` \| `"fireBurntOut"` \| `"stimulusResolved"` \| `"propertyChanged"` \| `"factChanged"` \| `"signalReceived"` \| `"volumeEntered"` \| `"volumeExited"` \| `"physicsImpact"` \| `"ArrowFired"` \| `"arrowImpact"` \| `"breakableBroken"` \| `"doorStateChanged"` \| `"doorBlocked"` \| `"lockUnlocked"` \| `"lockRefused"` \| `"switchUsed"` \| `"mechanismJammed"` | required | The sim event that triggers the rule (see src/content/cue-events.ts for its facts). |
| `rules[].match` | map of string → string or boolean | `{}` | Facts the event must have: a string fact equals the value, a list fact contains it, a boolean fact equals it. The most specific matching rule (most keys) wins. |
| `rules[].layer` | id | `"main"` | Rules compete per layer: one event plays at most one rule per layer (e.g. "impact" and "accent"). |
| `rules[].cue` | string | required | Sound manifest cue id to play; `{fact}` segments are filled from string facts (a missing fact plays nothing). |
| `rules[].at` | string | — | Event anchor to play at (an entity to follow or a fixed position); default: the event’s first anchor. |
| `rules[].variants` | integer > 0 | — | Pick randomly among this many variants of the cue (never the same twice in a row); default: all the manifest has. |
| `rules[].pitchJitter` | number 0–0.5 | `0` | Random playback-rate spread as a fraction: 0.05 = ±5%. |
| `rules[].volumeJitterDb` | number 0–12 | `0` | Random volume spread, ± dB. |
| `rules[].volumeDb` | number -60–12 | `0` | Fixed volume offset, dB. |
| `rules[].volumeBy` | object | — | Scale volume by a number fact (intensity: damage dealt, stimulus amount…). |
| `rules[].volumeBy.fact` | string | required | A number fact of the event, e.g. "total". |
| `rules[].volumeBy.min` | number | required | Fact value at (or below) which the cue plays at floorDb. |
| `rules[].volumeBy.max` | number | required | Fact value at (or above) which the cue plays at full volume. |
| `rules[].volumeBy.floorDb` | number -60–0 | `-12` | Volume offset at `min`, dB (≤ 0); linear in dB up to 0 at `max`. |
| `rules[].cooldownMs` | integer ≥ 0 | `0` | Minimum ms between two plays of this rule on the same anchor. |
| `rules[].priority` | integer 0–100 | — | Voice priority for this play (0–100); default: the manifest cue’s priority. |
